_read_me: This is an example, not a live registration. Resolve Studio 21.1 registers its own MCP server through File > Setup AI Assistants, and that dialog is the authority on the command, transport, and server name.

After running it once on the M4 Max, copy the block it wrote (Claude Code keeps user-scope servers in ~/.claude.json) into a real .mcp.json at the repo root so the repo carries the wiring, then delete this file.
Prerequisite inside Resolve: Preferences > System > General > External scripting = Local. Without it the server starts and every call fails silently.

The community bridge (npx davinci-resolve-mcp setup, MIT, Samuel Gursky) is a fallback if the native dialog does not offer Claude Code on this build. Do not run both; two servers on one Resolve instance race on the scripting socket.

davinci-resolve._note: Shape only. Replace command and args with what Setup AI Assistants writes. If it registers an HTTP or SSE endpoint instead, the block becomes {"type": "http", "url": "..."}.
